purpose: Test whether a frozen causal video codec plus block-autoregressive latent rectified flow provides a runnable, bounded-context next step after the pixel-space full-clip baseline. This is not a SOTA claim.

frozen_model.codec_checkpoint_and_latent_stats: record exact SHA256 after visual codec gate
frozen_model.backbone: factorised spatial/temporal DiT with signed local temporal RoPE
frozen_model.teacher_forcing: clean ground-truth history during training; generated history during rollout

validation.claim_limit: Denoising losses are optimization diagnostics, not perceptual video quality metrics.

final_evaluation.real_reference: same split, one camera (c0) per distinct source motion, 100 frames at 20 fps
qualitative_panels: fixed prompt and explicit noise seed
claim_limits: Prompt sensitivity is not semantic prompt correctness.
Palette centroids are visible part proxies, not anatomical joint estimates.
Real-reference metrics are distributional reference values, not paired ground truth for each generated motion.
A single training seed is feasibility evidence, not an architecture ranking.

extension_rule: Do not choose an endpoint from visual preference alone. Preserve 10k as the declared run. Extend with the same protocol only if the final-quarter fixed continuation validation remains materially improving and milestone videos remain non-collapsed; report the extension separately.
